sections.heading: Annual allowance
sections.body: Full-time employees receive 160 hours of PTO per calendar year.

sections.heading: Request process
sections.body: Submit PTO at least 5 business days before leave. Manager approval is required.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.body: Active full-time employees are eligible for medical benefits from their hire date.

sections.heading: Enrollment
sections.body: Enroll within 30 calendar days of your hire date.

sections.heading: First day
sections.body: Complete identity verification and security training on your first day.

sections.heading: Equipment
sections.body: Your manager requests a laptop before your start date.

sections.heading: Receipts
sections.body: Itemized receipts are required for expenses above 25 USD.

sections.heading: Submission
sections.body: Submit expenses within 30 calendar days of purchase.

sections.heading: Allowance
sections.body: Eligible employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave.

sections.heading: Notice
sections.body: Give HR 30 calendar days of notice when practical.

sections.heading: Schedule
sections.body: Payroll is paid on the 15th and final business day of each month.

sections.heading: Missing pay
sections.body: For missing or incorrect pay, prepare a Payroll support ticket with the pay period. Do not include bank account numbers.

sections.heading: Location
sections.body: Employees must work from their approved country of employment.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: Discuss a permanent work location change with HR before moving.

sections.heading: Allowance
sections.body: Employees receive 80 hours of sick leave per year.

sections.heading: Notice
sections.body: Notify your manager before your scheduled start when possible.

sections.heading: Completion
sections.body: All employees complete security training annually.

sections.heading: Reporting
sections.body: Report suspected phishing using the security reporting channel.

sections.heading: Approval
sections.body: Manager approval is required before booking business travel.

sections.heading: Class
sections.body: Book economy class for flights shorter than 6 hours.

sections.heading: Calendar
sections.body: The local holiday calendar follows the employee's country of employment.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: Ask HR if your local holiday is missing from the calendar.

sections.heading: Allowance
sections.body: Employees may request up to 1000 USD annually for approved learning.

sections.heading: Approval
sections.body: Get manager approval before purchasing a course.

sections.heading: Candidate notes
sections.body: Candidate notes are accessible only to assigned recruiters and HR administrators.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Remove candidate records after the documented retention period.

sections.heading: Restricted planning
sections.body: Compensation planning worksheets are restricted to HR administrators.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: Do not share individual compensation data through employee chat.

sections.heading: Check-ins
sections.body: Managers hold a check-in with direct reports every two weeks.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.body: Escalate employee relations concerns to HR.

sections.heading: Old allowance
sections.body: Full-time employees receive 120 hours of PTO per calendar year.
